antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 8300nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in chondrocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Gentle regeneration: 345 THz (870nm) at low power, continuous, targets neuron mitochondria targeting cco_water_channel in chondrocyte.
